compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description: Each gate/LLM operation logs its RESOLVED cost-affecting settings (prompt cache style, model id, region, retry caps, context caps, fallback chain) as a single fingerprint in the per-call spend record; a change in fingerprint between runs raises an alert (SNS/session-log sweep). Rationale: the Aug 10 regression left config files correct but silently collapsed the EFFECTIVE cache capability across the fallback chain for 17 days at material cost (figures in the local-only incident report). Config-source checks cannot catch this class; only the resolved effective values can. Acceptance criteria: (1) fingerprint of resolved cost-affecting settings persisted with every spend record; (2) a documented, operation-linked check (not CI-only, per project.portability) that compares current fingerprint to previous and surfaces changes loudly; (3) covers cache style, model, region, retries, max context; (4) tests proving a simulated capability collapse changes the fingerprint. Note: any new config key/mechanism must carry a mechanism-ok justification per the mechanism-delta ratchet.
compiled_state.title: Effective cost-config fingerprint canary for LLM operations
